platform_interruption.symptom: configure failed: no Visual Studio installation with the MSVC x64 toolset was found
platform_interruption.actual_cause: VS Build Tools installation was RENAMED from C:\Program to C:\Program1
platform_interruption.why_misdiagnosed_initially: vswhere kept reporting the old path while marking the instance isComplete:false, so -latest returned nothing and -all returned a non-existent directory; initially recorded as possible toolchain loss, corrected by the user
platform_interruption.fix: tools/repro/native_windows_env.ps1 now resolves via BMX_VS_ROOT override, then vswhere (-latest then -all), then directory scan of C:\ and both Program Files roots, validating EVERY candidate against VC\Auxiliary\Build\vcvars64.bat before acceptance; it prints the chosen root and how it was found
